lead.headline: Golden catches one ball; you lead 14.9 to 3.4
lead.deck: One catch on five targets in Los Angeles, and Jacobs sat again. Tuten and Likely have no new reports; both Sunday fallbacks stand.
lead.body: Bad news first. Matthew Golden caught one of five targets for 4.9 points in the Rams' 26-13 win, against a 16.7 projection; no injury was reported. Josh Jacobs was inactive again with the finger. Bhayshul Tuten has not practised since Wednesday's DNP, and Isaiah Likely was limited Wednesday; Thursday's reports arrive this afternoon. The Rams D/ST scored 10, so you lead JuiceJam 14.9 to 3.4. George Pickens plays Philadelphia at 15:30; JuiceJam have Jahmyr Gibbs at noon. Sunday's plan is unchanged: if Tuten sits, Jonathan Taylor starts; if Likely sits, add Kyle Pitts Sr. and drop Aaron Jones Sr. ESPN has it a coin flip.

doFirst.headline: Two decisions, made in advance
doFirst.deck: Tuten's and Likely's fallbacks, checked Sunday 10:30.
doFirst.note: Nothing to move today. If Tuten sits, start Taylor; if Likely sits, add Pitts (free agent, no priority) and drop Aaron Jones.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to move this morning: the lineup is the projection lineup and Pickens plays at 15:30.

cards.headline: If Likely sits, add Pitts
cards.reason: Likely: groin, limited Wednesday. No tight end on the bench.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup (130.7); Taylor and Gordon tie at 14.0. Tuten and Likely are conditional.

wire.deck: Every name on the screen comes from Green Bay-Los Angeles, and all pass. Pitts is the only wire name that matters — and only if Likely sits.
